label: Terrain invented for this edition, shaped to fit the book. (Draft label.) AI-made: generated by code written by an AI model, Claude (the coding agent, a closed model); no image model. Every book fact is pinned; everything else is invented. Not by the author.
license: Terrain generated in code for Snowmoon, the book by Vitalik Buterin, 2026-10-11. GPL-3.0, like the book.

assist.drafted: the generator code, its masks, spines and parameters; no model generates terrain or images

region.contains: Veridia, Northshore and the Arctic's southern edge, the United Cities and the land to their south

dzego.note: its own inset: the book does not say where Dzego lies relative to the United Cities (owner, 2026-10-11)

method: Continent masks (ours) as signed distance fields, their coasts made irregular by domain-warped layered noise; mountain chains of ridged noise along chosen spines; hills; soft pulls then hard pins for every book fact and Design's checked cues; droplet hydraulic erosion (after Beyer 2015), pins re-applied; the book's river carved; priority-flood, keeping lakes only in basins at least 40 cells and 50 m deep (cities: 400 cells, 4 m), the rest filled as sediment; D8 flow and accumulation; rivers above a drainage area (region 3,500 km², Dzego 2,500 km², cities 1.5 km²), draining to the sea or off the frame; mean annual temperature -25 + 52·cos(latitude) °C minus 6.5 °C per km; rain carried by the prevailing winds (trades below 30°, westerlies 30-62°, polar easterlies above), falling where air climbs and lost in the lee; biomes from temperature and rain; forced cover where the book names a forest. Render: multi-directional hillshade, muted hypsometric tint blended with the biome, snow above the snow line, water by depth, rivers by flow, a tree-mark texture on forest.
